you_should_know.title: Neighbors gather to share memories of family members killed in Hopkins and Burnsville
you_should_know.summary: A murder-suicide at a daycare in Hopkins, a suburb about 8 miles west of Minneapolis, and a home in Burnsville, a suburb south of the city, unfolded over the week. A search warrant described officers finding Kristen Brown and her 7-year-old daughter Evie dead in the kitchen; the Hennepin County Medical Examiner then identified the victims and the alleged perpetrator. The Brown family released a statement through the Hopkins Police Department and spoke about their grief, and neighbors gathered at Downtown Park in Hopkins to remember Evie, Kristen and Alice Brown.
